high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the user "shreya__chaudhry," who has a verified account indicated by the blue checkmark next to their username. The post features a woman posing with her back to the camera, showcasing a white dress with an open back design. She has long, wavy dark hair that cascades over her shoulder and is wearing small hoop earrings. Her pose is elegant, with one arm raised and resting on her head, while the other arm is bent at the elbow. The background is plain and light-colored, which helps to highlight the subject and the details of the dress.
